mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 1% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO falls > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 100,000 signals strong labor market conditions, boosting earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS rises > 100,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Housing Starts index above 5% signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction-related earnings and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where HOUST rises > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points combined with a monthly decline in nonfarm payrolls above 100,000 signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 100,000 (t-test p > 0.05).
